name: Ringing Order
description: Inside each key up to eight overtones take turns like bell ringers, swapping places row by row, so a held chord carries an endless soft pattern.

params.name: Ringers
params.description: Overtones that ring inside each key. Few leave a bare tune of high and low; many fill the row into a full peal.

params.name: Method
params.description: The order they ring in: a falling roll, neighbours swapping, a treble that leads, a pair that trembles, two lines that cross, or one alone and then another.

params.name: Row time
params.description: How long one row lasts. Short rows flicker and pulse; long ones let one overtone after another come forward like a slow tide.

params.name: Gap
params.description: The rest after every row, counted in rows. The ring breathes in it, and with much of it the key comes in waves.

params.name: Overlap
params.description: How long each ringer sounds beside its neighbours. Low gives separate short strikes, and high melts the row into one swell that never parts.

params.name: Voice
params.description: What each ringer is: cast metal, a blown reed, rubbed glass, a plucked string, a band of breath, or a closed mouth an octave below.

params.name: Series
params.description: Which overtones the ringers hold: the near ones, every other one, stacked fifths, only distant ones, or the other keys you hold.

params.name: Tower
params.description: How the keys share the clock: rolled together, each on its own path behind the last, two sides that answer each other, or one key after another.

params.name: Weight
params.description: Which end of the row is heavy. Up, the first ringer is loudest and the row falls away; down, each row grows towards its last.

params.name: Swing
params.description: Gathers the blows of each half row and leans on the first, from an even walk through a lilt to two broad chords in every row.

params.name: Crossing
params.description: Where two keys have close overtones, the last one rung keeps the place and the other steps back. It clears a thick chord and passes tones between keys.

params.name: Covering tone
params.description: A steady low tone of the key itself under the ringers, touched again as every row begins. At zero only the ringers are heard.

params.name: Muffle
params.description: Leather on the clappers. The first half dulls every second row like an echo, and the second half dulls the others too.

params.name: Bite
params.description: The touch at the start of each ringer: the tick of a clapper or a nail, or the air before and around a blown tone.

params.name: Body
params.description: How much of each ringer's own upper sound is heard, from a plain round tone to a bright full one. Playing harder opens it too.

params.name: Beat
params.description: A slow waver in each ringer, as two near tones make when they ring together. High turns it into a shiver.

params.name: Tilt
params.description: The balance of low and high ringers. Down keeps the high ones a faint gleam, and up lets them lead.

params.name: Place
params.description: How far apart the places of the row stand between left and right, so a ringer that changes place is heard to move.

params.name: Attack
params.description: How softly each ringer and each key comes in. Blown voices take longer than struck ones at the same setting.

params.name: Release
params.description: How long a key rings on after it is let go. The ringers keep their order while they fade.

params.name: Volume
params.description: Overall output level of the instrument.

origin.note: Written for live-mix on cpp/kit. The orders are the plain permutations of change ringing (neighbours exchange places from row to row); every ringer is four turning partials with a gesture of its own, voiced by measurement.
